description: Multi-series charts from the Svelte 5 data grid's charting prop. Point the panel at a Split by column and it draws one series per distinct value, grouped or stacked with a Stacked toggle, over the Group by and Value pickers, so Region by Product revenue becomes grouped or stacked bars. Change the pickers or filter a column and every series re-aggregates from the live grid rows.
keywords: svelte grouped bar chart from grid

faq.question: How do I get one series per product?
faq.answer: Choose Product in Split by. The panel groups the rows by Region, then by Product within each region, and aggregates Value per pair into a series.

faq.question: What does Stacked do?
faq.answer: It stacks the series within each category instead of placing them side by side, and 100 percent mode normalises each stack to its total.

faq.question: Can the split be set in code?
faq.answer: Yes. charting accepts series for the split-by column along with dimension and measures so the panel opens with the split already applied, and stacked sets the initial stacking.
